comparison.objective: Probe a duct to locate and externally mark a blockage, then withdraw the rod; candidate finishes threaded inserts by tang removal.
comparison.physical_skill: Contact-based depth sensing, marker placement, and rod withdrawal versus bimanual coaxial impact fracture and fragment handling.
comparison.success_condition: Correct blockage mark with rod removed and released versus four safe fractures and physical containment of all four tangs.
comparison.reason: Shared insertion/withdrawal primitives do not establish overlap; the central sensing-and-marking ability differs from controlled notch fracture.
